generic_rules_implemented: axis representation reachability computed per axis, never gated on the sibling axis or on a complete canonical (x,y) pair array
declared bridge transforms traversed in both directions; dimensionless ratios reverse only under their declared basis
SAME_MEASUREMENT_REPRESENTATION relation distinct from DERIVED_TRANSFORM; independently digitized, never point-inverted
document-defined named normalizations bound generically (definition sentence + caption use); unresolved without document evidence
one authority: pair verdicts, overlay authorization, missing-context and Why-comparable all read representation reachability
role-aware timing specialization: source family preserved (pulse stays pulse, exposure stays exposure); role prefix only from step/species evidence
dose commits to NEITHER family: dose-worded timings keep their own unresolved kind (dose_time); no automatic dose->pulse or dose->exposure

point-to-case timing identity: families must match where both are resolved; a cycle-side identification is accepted only when a family is genuinely unresolved AND the case states exactly one timing kind for that side/step/species; every resolved link records its identity basis
one physical timing slot = one Condition Case dimension; generic records fold into qualified ones only under value agreement; conflicts stay visible
resolved case facts separate case-defining conditions from known context, scoped per case; chemistry never leaks across a paper's processes
extraction-vs-label family disagreements surfaced verbatim on the series (axis_family_discrepancies), never silently renamed
